questions.question:
Which of the mathematical signs should be interchanged in the below equation to make it mathematically correct?

72 ÷ 4 × 64 + 8 - 24 = 80
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) ÷ and × 

Given equation is : 72 ÷ 4 × 64 + 8 - 24 = 80 

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 72 × 4 ÷ 64 + 8 - 24 = 80

⇒ 72 × __**4 ÷ 64**__ + 8 - 24 = 80

⇒ __**72 × 0.0625**__ + 8 - 24 = 80

⇒ __**4.5 + 8**__ - 24 = 80

⇒ __**12.5 - 24**__ = 80

⇒ -11.5 ≠ 80

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) - and +

Given equation is : 72 ÷ 4 × 64 + 8 - 24 = 80 

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 72 ÷ 4 × 64 - 8 + 24 = 80

⇒ __**72 ÷ 4**__ × 64 - 8 + 24 = 80

⇒ __**18 × 64**__ - 8 + 24 = 80

⇒ __**1152**__ - 8 __**+ 24**__ = 80

⇒ __**1179 - 8**__ = 80

⇒ 1171 ≠ 80

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) ÷ and +

Given equation is : 72 ÷ 4 × 64 + 8 - 24 = 80 

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 72 + 4 × 64 ÷ 8 - 24 = 80

⇒ 72 + 4 × __**64 ÷ 8**__ - 24 = 80

⇒ 72 + __**4 × 8**__ - 24 = 80

⇒ __**72 + 32**__ - 24 = 80

⇒ __**104 - 24**__ = 80

⇒ **80**** = 80**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 4) - and × 

Given equation is : 72 ÷ 4 × 64 + 8 - 24 = 80 

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 72 ÷ 4 - 64 + 8 × 24 = 80

⇒ __**72 ÷ 4**__ - 64 + 8 × 24 = 80

⇒ 18 - 64 + __**8 × 24**__ = 80

⇒ __**18**__ - 64 __**+ 192**__ = 80

⇒ __**210 - 64**__ = 80

⇒ 146 ≠ 80

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"÷ and +".**

questions.question: Seven students of a school, E, F, G, H, I, J and K have all obtained different scores. E's score was less than only one student. K scored more than only one person. H's score was more than I's but less than E's. Neither F nor G received the lowest score. I's score was more than K's. Who received the least score?
questions.solution:
Seven students of a school, E, F, G, H, I, J and K have all obtained different scores.

1) E's score was less than only one student.

__ > E > __ > __ > __ > __ > __

2) K scored more than only one person.

__ > E > __ > __ > __ > K > __

3) H's score was more than I's but less than E's.

4) I's score was more than K's.

Case I: __ > E > H > I > __ > K > __

Case II: __ > E > __ > H > I > K > __

5) Neither F nor G received the lowest score.

Case I: F/G > E > H > I > G/F > K > __

Case II: F/G > E > G/F > H > I > K > __

And, J's score the least one, as only place left.

Case I: F/G > E > H > I > G/F > K > J

Case II: F/G > E > G/F > H > I > K > J

So, 'J' received the least score.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
